recent_posts.title: Collaborate with Claude across Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic has made Claude for Excel, PowerPoint, and Word generally available, with Claude for Outlook entering public beta for all paid plans. The integration enables a single persistent conversation across all four Microsoft 365 apps, so context carries over as users move between tasks. Changes made in one app (e.g., Excel) automatically propagate to linked content in others (e.g., PowerPoint charts, Word memos). Claude for Outlook can triage inboxes, draft replies, and schedule calendar invites, with users reviewing everything before sending. Enterprise features include OpenTelemetry support for audit logging, an Analytics API, and the ability to route traffic through Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI, or Microsoft Foundry. Microsoft 365 Copilot customers can also access Claude models directly within Excel and PowerPoint.

recent_posts.title:
Live from Code with Claude: we're launching dreaming in Claude Managed Agents as a research preview.

Outcomes, multiagent orchestration, and webhooks are now in public beta.
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic is launching Claude Managed Agents as a research preview, announced live at the Code with Claude event. The release includes three features now in public beta: outcomes, multiagent orchestration, and webhooks. This marks a significant step toward agentic AI workflows built on Claude.

recent_posts.title: New in Claude Managed Agents: dreaming, outcomes, and multiagent orchestration
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic has launched several new features for Claude Managed Agents: 'dreaming' (a scheduled process that reviews past sessions to extract patterns and self-improve agent memory), 'outcomes' (a rubric-based grading system where a separate evaluator checks agent output and triggers self-correction), and multiagent orchestration (a lead agent delegates subtasks to specialist subagents running in parallel on a shared filesystem). Webhooks are also now available for async notifications. Real-world users include Harvey (legal drafting, ~6x completion rate improvement), Netflix (parallel log analysis), Spiral (parallel writing with quality enforcement), and Wisedocs (50% faster document reviews).

recent_posts.title: Deploying Claude across financial services
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic has published a deployment guide for financial services firms using Claude. It covers the full product lineup including Claude Chat, Cowork, Code, Microsoft 365 add-ins, the Claude Platform, and Claude Managed Agents. The guide includes 10 pre-built finance agent templates (pitch builders, KYC screeners, GL reconcilers, etc.), customer stories from AIG, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, IG Group, and Moody's, and a three-phase adoption playbook (foundation, pilot, scale) targeting AI leaders and engineers rolling out Claude within financial institutions.

recent_posts.title: How a non-technical project manager built and shipped a stress management app with Claude Code in six weeks
recent_posts.summary: Kostiantyn Vlasenko, a non-technical project manager at Mythical Games, built and shipped Respiro — an iOS stress management app with real-time stress detection and guided breathing exercises — using Claude Code with zero prior coding experience. In roughly six weeks (72 hours of active building), he created a multi-agent architecture with 15+ specialized subagents, rewrote the app from React Native to Swift, navigated the Apple Developer Program, and set up analytics and marketing — all guided by Claude. The app is now live on the App Store with hundreds of users. Vlasenko credits his project management background for making agent orchestration feel natural, and has since introduced his Claude workflows to the engineering team at his day job.

recent_posts.title: Building AI agents for the enterprise
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic has published a guide on enterprise AI transformation focused on deploying agentic AI at scale. It covers three pillars of enterprise AI adoption, strategies for overcoming the 'agentic thinking divide,' employee upskilling, compressing information-dense processes, and building revenue-generating product capabilities. The guide includes case studies from L'Oreal, Lyft, and Rakuten, plus a six-month deployment framework for Claude Cowork, Anthropic's enterprise offering that brings agentic AI to teams without requiring custom builds.

recent_posts.title: Claude Security is now in public beta
recent_posts.summary: Claude Security is now in public beta for Claude Enterprise customers. Powered by Claude Opus 4.7, it scans codebases for vulnerabilities, traces data flows across files and modules, and generates targeted patches — without requiring API integration or custom agent builds. Key features include scheduled scans, multi-stage validation to reduce false positives, confidence ratings per finding, and integrations with Slack, Jira, CSV/Markdown export, and webhooks. Major security vendors including CrowdStrike, Microsoft Security, Palo Alto Networks, SentinelOne, and Wiz are embedding Opus 4.7 into their platforms. The release reflects lessons from a two-month limited preview with hundreds of enterprises, focusing on detection quality, fast scan-to-fix cycles, and ongoing coverage rather than one-off audits.

recent_posts.title: New guide Deploying Claude across the enterprise with Claude Cowork
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic has published a deployment guide for Claude Cowork, a desktop AI tool that extends Claude's agent capabilities beyond developers to all enterprise workers — analysts, lawyers, marketers, and more. The guide covers a five-level adoption maturity model, how to structure a pilot, a six-month rollout roadmap, and real-world use cases from Anthropic's own finance, legal, sales, and product teams, as well as customers like Thomson Reuters, Zapier, and Jamf. Claude Cowork integrates with local files, Slack, Google Drive, the browser, Excel, and PowerPoint, and supports plugins and custom commands.

recent_posts.title: Claude API skill now in CodeRabbit, JetBrains, Resolve AI, and Warp
recent_posts.summary: Anthropic's claude-api skill, first introduced in Claude Code in March, is now bundled in CodeRabbit, JetBrains (including Junie), Resolve AI, and Warp. The skill provides production-ready Claude API code generation with built-in knowledge of agent patterns, prompt caching, context compaction, and model migration. It stays current as Anthropic's SDKs evolve. Developers can ask Claude to improve cache hit rates, add context compaction to agents, upgrade to the latest model, or build deep research agents using Claude Managed Agents. The skill is open source and any coding agent can bundle it via a ~20-line CI setup.
